name: saveinstance
description: Serializes the DataModel or a selected Instance to a Roblox XML place or model file and returns the saved path string. The root can be passed as the first argument, supplied as options.Object, or omitted to use game.

parameters.name: rootOrOptions
parameters.description: Optional root Instance to save, or the SaveInstanceOptions table when no root is passed separately.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional save options table. Used as argument 2 when argument 1 is an Instance.
